QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Swamp Data Collection
QuestInfo.0: You've discovered the data collector in the Swamp Region, but it needs to be activated before you can use it.
QuestInfo.1: According to Eremos, the Data Collector will analyze any sample items you obtain from hunting monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You obtained monster data from the Swamp Region and sent it to Eremose per his request.
